name: HemOncSigTargetType
title: HemOnc Sig Dose Target Type
description: Small code system distinguishing the *target* expressed by a Sig's doseQuantity from the *computed* mg dose. Used as ActivityDefinition.dosage.doseAndRate.type. A target requires a CQL helper to convert into an administered mg quantity at $apply time.

concept.display: Target dose expressed in mg/m² (multiply by BSA at $apply)
concept.definition: The doseQuantity is the literal per-m² target from the protocol. Computed mg = doseQuantity.value × BSA(patient, formula, cap).
The doseQuantity is the target AUC. Computed mg = AUC × (effectiveGFR + 25), where effectiveGFR is min(GFR(patient, formula), GFR-cap).

concept.display: Target dose expressed in mg/kg (multiply by weight)
concept.definition: The doseQuantity is the literal per-kg target. Computed mg = doseQuantity.value × WeightKg(patient).

concept.display: Literal absolute mg dose (no patient-specific computation needed)
concept.definition: The doseQuantity is the dispensed mg as-is. CQL helpers are not invoked.

concept.display: Computed mg dose derived from a target-AUC (provenance marker)
concept.definition: Set on MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.doseAndRate.type after $apply, so the original target paradigm is recoverable from the order.

concept.display: Computed mg dose derived from a per-m² target (provenance marker)
